pages.observed: Option A 0.0 to 0.8 s. Airport curb scene, white driverless SUV with roof sensor enters from the left frame edge and advances toward a marked pickup bay. Phone card top left shows route map and Ride requested. Caption appears from 0.2 s in lower middle band. Illustration label chip top left.

Option A 1.0 to 1.8 s. The white car advances into the marked bay with a red brake lamp glow at its rear and then sits in the bay. Car body sits just above the caption box top edge. Phone card still reads Ride requested.

Option A 2.0 to 2.8 s. Curb shot holds with the car parked in the bay while a small Texas locator card draws top right. At 2.6 s a cut to the cab from behind the front seats shows both front seats empty, the steering wheel and a dash screen with a route line. The lower seat backs sit below and behind the caption band.

Option A 3.0 to 3.8 s. Cab view behind empty front seats. The steering wheel visibly rotates with no hands, its tan marker moving clockwise, while the airport sign outside moves off to the right edge of the windshield. Caption band covers the top of the seat backs only; the wheel stays above it.

Option A 4.0 to 4.8 s. The cab view holds still: wheel marker stays at the right, the airport sign edge stays at the right edge of the windshield, the windshield is mostly blank pale sky. Locator card shows the full Texas outline. No sampled movement in these five frames.

Option A 5.0 to 5.8 s. Cab view ends at 5.2 s. At 5.4 s a cut to a closer curb shot: a large tilted phone covers the left half of the parked white car; the phone still reads Ride requested, Finding a car through 5.8 s. Caption the airport included sits below the car, phone bottom clears it.

Option A 6.0 to 6.8 s. On the phone the car pin slides along the blue route to the destination pin and the status flips from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s. The real car stays parked at the bay behind the phone. Caption off from 6.6 s.

Option A 7.0 to 7.8 s. Cut to a pale street map lying on a wooden table with three small pins and a February calendar page at its top right. The map is pale with faint grid; a blue river line begins to draw at 7.8 s. Caption The service began in February sits on the table below the map.

Option A 8.0 to 8.8 s. On the tabletop map a blue river line and thin grey roads plus a faint ring road draw in progressively. The map content stays small and pale at phone size; pins remain tiny. February calendar page stays at the map top right. The locator card fades away.

Option A 9.0 to 9.8 s. The map is shown closer from 9.4 s. A tag reading 60 square miles, Limited area lands at the top of the map and a February calendar page slides in at lower right. A short dark outline stroke starts at the upper left. The three pins are small dots near the river.

Option A 10.0 to 10.8 s. A dark outline line traces clockwise around the pins, from the upper left across the top under the 60 square miles tag and down the right side; it is still open at 10.8 s. February page sits at the lower left of the map above the caption band.

Option A 11.0 to 11.8 s. The dark outline closes into an irregular polygon around the three pins and the river, and a grey shading fills it. The 60 square miles tag sits just above the polygon and the February page at lower left. All above the caption band.

Option A 12.0 to 12.8 s. The completed shaded service polygon holds on the map with the 60 square miles tag above. The pins inside move slightly and a very small white car mark is visible near the lower left pin. Caption clears at 12.8 s.

Option A 13.0 to 13.8 s. Map holds at 13.0 s, then a cut to a straight-down creek plan: brown water band with pale current streaks across the upper half, pale sand shelf and green bank with round tree crowns below. A white car seen from above sits at the bottom edge of the brown water, its roof pod and dark empty seat shapes visible, pale splash marks at its right end. Car bottom edge sits just above the caption box top. Disclosure chip top left reads Illustration. A different car, April 20th account.

Option A 14.0 to 14.8 s. Overhead creek. The white car stays at the lower edge of the brown water for most of the second, with splash crescents at its right end; at 14.8 s it has moved a little to the left and is slightly rotated. Car underside sits about level with the caption box top; the car body itself is above the caption box.

Option A 15.0 to 15.8 s. The car edges into the brown water with growing splash. At 15.4 s the view is from higher: far bank with a tree and pale ledge at top, car in the water on the right. By 15.8 s the car has rotated about twenty degrees, drawn larger, a dark shadow appears offset under its lower edge and a pale trailing line extends to its left. Car lower corner is just above the caption box top; caption does not cover the car.

Option A 16.0 to 16.8 s. The rotated white car, with a dark shadow offset on the water beneath it and splash crescents at its upper right end, is carried leftward along the brown creek and exits past the left frame edge; at 16.8 s only part of the car remains visible at the left. The car stays in the water band above the caption box throughout.

Option A 17.0 to 17.8 s. Only a splash fragment remains at the left edge at 17.0 to 17.2 s; by 17.4 s the creek frame is empty water with the car gone and no caption. At 17.6 s a cut to a residential street: houses, a live oak and a street sign behind a white car standing in shallow brown floodwater with its reflection, a dark rounded shape at the right edge, pale sidewalk in the foreground. New chip reads Illustration. Another car, earlier in April.

Option A 18.0 to 18.8 s. The white car moves slowly rightward along the flooded street while the brown water line rises over its wheels; by 18.6 s the lower half of the wheels is under water. Houses and a live oak behind. The car sits in the band just above the caption box.

Option A 19.0 to 19.8 s. The white car sits stopped near the frame center with brown water up its body sides and wheels hidden. Small amber glows appear at its front and rear corners from 19.6 s. Car is small in a wide frame, located just above the caption box.

Option A 20.0 to 20.8 s. Closer shot of the stopped white car with brown water at its sills and a reflection beneath. Side windows show seat headrests and no people. Amber lamps at front and rear blink on and off across the samples. Background softened. Car above caption band.

Option A 21.0 to 21.8 s. Same close street-flood shot: the stopped white car with water at its sills, empty headrests in the windows, its amber lamps blinking. The car and water hold still. Caption below the car.

Option A 22.0 to 22.8 s. Flood car held at 22.0 s, then a cut to an olive wall above a brown desk where a cream card headed Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall slides in from the right with a pen beside it. At 22.8 s a field begins typing Reca and Sof. Card is partly cropped at right edge; caption overlaps the lower left corner area of the card at 22.4 to 22.6 s.

Option A 23.0 to 23.8 s. The recall card settles mid-desk and its rows type in: Recall type Software, then Potential units affected 3,791 by 23.6 s. Card sits above the caption box. Large olive wall areas above and below the desk band.

Option A 24.0 to 24.8 s. The completed card holds, then at 24.6 s the framing changes: card at top, a faint grid of empty car outlines below on the desk. At 24.8 s three white car icons have filled the top row's left cells. Caption sits just below the grid.

Option A 25.0 to 25.8 s. The grid of white car icons fills row by row under the card. A forearm in a blue sleeve brings a wooden rubber stamp in from the right and positions it over the card's upper area by 25.8 s. Grid ends just above the caption box.

Option A 26.0 to 26.8 s. The full grid of car icons sits under the card. A counter tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in and settles between card and grid. The hand presses the stamp on the card's upper right; at 26.8 s an amber outlined imprint beginning So is visible beneath the lifting stamp. All above caption box.

Option A 27.0 to 27.8 s. The amber Software recall imprint stays on the card as the hand and stamp withdraw off the right edge. The completed card, counter tag and full icon grid hold, all above the caption box.

Option A 28.0 to 28.8 s. Record composition holds briefly, then at 28.4 s a cut to a side view of a road: grey lane with a dashed line, lamp post, trees and skyline. A white car with a roof pod drives in from the left. At 28.8 s a faint card quoting the recall sentence fades in near the top. The car's lower body sits just above the caption box. No standing water visible yet.

Option A 29.0 to 29.8 s. The car is tracked in place on the lane while the dashes and roadside elements slide left behind it, with small speed streaks at its rear. The full recall sentence card is legible at top. No water on the road yet. The car's wheels sit just above the caption box top edge.

Option A 30.0 to 30.8 s. The tracked car continues along the lane; at 30.6 s its rear brake lamp lights red and is brighter at 30.8 s. A pale grey patch of standing water appears at the right edge of the lane at 30.8 s. Car sits just above the caption box.

Option A 31.0 to 31.8 s. With brake lamp lit, the car approaches a pale grey patch of standing water at the lane's right edge; the background motion slows. Water patch is partly hidden behind the caption box's right edge region; car remains above the caption box.

Option A 32.0 to 32.8 s. The car creeps toward the pale water patch on the right; caption clears at 32.6 s. At 32.8 s a cut to a close side view of the car filling the frame width, with a thin pale wavy line at its tires and the recall sentence card above. The word may is not visibly highlighted yet.

Option A 33.0 to 33.8 s. Close side view: the white car holds frame center with a headlamp streak while a pale grey standing water edge enlarges from the right toward its front wheel. Thin ripple lines at tire level. Recall sentence card above; the word may is not visibly highlighted. Car and water above caption box.

Option A 34.0 to 34.8 s. The front wheel rolls onto the pale grey standing water; by 34.8 s the front wheel is in the water with small spray streaks. The word may in the recall card is highlighted amber from 34.2 s. All above caption band.

Option A 35.0 to 35.8 s. The car is now driving in the pale grey standing water with V-shaped wake lines from both tires and a faint reflection below. The word may stays highlighted in amber on the card. The wake's lowest lines reach the caption box top; the car itself stays above it.

Option A 36.0 to 36.8 s. The car keeps driving in the standing water with wake lines and a reflection, may still highlighted on the card. Caption clears by 36.6 s, leaving the car and wake unobstructed. No stop is drawn.

Option A 37.0 to 37.8 s. The recall card returns, larger, with its stamp. A Remedy row types in reading The remedy is currently under development. and its area lights pale amber. Card sits above the caption box.

Option A 38.0 to 38.8 s. A hand in a blue sleeve brings a pen in from the right; its tip comes to rest at the end of the line The remedy is currently under development. on the lit remedy row. Card above caption band.

Option A 39.0 to 39.8 s. With the pen still resting at the remedy line, a second forearm in a blue sleeve brings a wooden stamp from the lower right and positions it over the lower part of the lit remedy row. Two separate forearms enter from the right edge at once. The stamp arm's sleeve crosses the card bottom; card and stamp above caption box.

Option A 40.0 to 40.8 s. The stamp presses onto the lower remedy row, then lifts and moves away down-right, leaving an amber imprint reading Under development under the remedy text. The pen hand remains at the remedy line. Imprint is above the caption box; the stamp arm's lower part crosses toward the caption band.

Option A 41.0 to 41.8 s. The stamped card holds as the pen hand and stamp arm withdraw. At 41.6 s a cut to a wet lot with four white cars in a diagonal row, a small Vehicle maps card hanging from a wire and an April calendar page on a post. At 41.8 s a tag ending in ther limits slides in from the left, partly cropped. The front car sits above the caption box.

Option A 42.0 to 42.8 s. A tag with a rain cloud icon reading Weather limits, tightened slides along the overhead wire and pins near the center. The four parked cars hold still; the front car sits just above the caption box. April page and Vehicle maps card remain small at upper right.

Option A 43.0 to 43.8 s. The lot composition holds: four parked white cars, Weather limits tightened tag on the wire, small Vehicle maps card and April page. Only the tag shifts slightly and tilts at 43.8 s. Caption below the front car.
Option A 44.0 to 44.8 s. Same lot composition holds; the Weather limits tag rocks slightly on the wire and nothing else changes. Same caption.

Option A 45.0 to 45.8 s. Wide lot holds, caption clears at 45.4 s. At 45.6 s a cut to a closer view: the front car large at left with the row receding to the right, the Weather limits tightened tag larger at top left, Vehicle maps card and an April page at right. No check marks yet. The front car body sits above the caption box.

Option A 46.0 to 46.8 s. Round check-mark badges pop up above each car roof in order from the front car toward the back of the row; by 46.8 s four checks are visible, the farthest smallest. The April page at right still shows no date number. Cars above caption box.

Option A 47.0 to 47.8 s. All visible cars carry check badges. A small check mark is added to the Vehicle maps card by 47.4 s. The April page still shows only April with no visible date number. Composition otherwise holds above the caption box.
Option A 48.0 to 48.8 s. Checked car row holds; at 48.8 s the small calendar page at right flips to show a large 20. The calendar page is small at the frame's right edge. Cars above caption box.
Option A 49.0 to 49.8 s. The calendar now reads April 20 at the right; checks remain over all cars and on the Vehicle maps card. Composition holds; caption clears by 49.8 s.

Option A 50.0 to 50.8 s. Return to the airport curb wide shot from the opening: the white car parked in the bay, phone card reading Arriving, At the curb. New chip reads Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. The car's doors stay closed in these samples. Caption sits below the car.

Option A 51.0 to 51.8 s. At the curb, the parked white car's rear side door swings open from 51.2 s, revealing a dark interior with a tan seat by 51.6 to 51.8 s. The door is small at phone size. Phone card reads Arriving. Car above the caption box.

Option A 52.0 to 52.8 s. The car holds at the curb with its rear door open. At 52.8 s a cut to a wider curb view: car with open door, a small phone on the bench, and a small recall card with the remedy row and Under development stamp in the foreground on the road. The card text is small at phone size.

Option A 53.0 to 53.8 s. The car waits at the curb with its door open while a small tilted recall card in the foreground road area slides slightly left and settles. Card text small but the remedy line is readable at full sample scale. Card sits just above the caption box.

Option A 54.0 to 54.8 s. The recall card slides closer and enlarges in the foreground, its remedy row lit with The remedy is currently under development. and an Under development stamp. By 54.4 s the card overlaps the bottom of the car and at 54.6 s it covers the car's lower-left wheel and door area. Card sits directly above the caption box.

Option A 55.0 to 55.8 s. The car with its open door at the curb and the recall card in front of it hold together; the card covers the lower part of the car's left side. Card bottom sits directly above the caption box.

Option A 56.0 to 56.8 s. At 56.4 s the frame splits: top half shows the white car at the curb with its rear door open beside the airport sign; bottom half is a brown desk with the recall card's remedy row stamped Under development and a small phone showing the ride route. Caption sits on the desk below the card.

Option A 57.0 to 57.8 s. The split holds: car with its rear door open at the curb above, recall card with the stamped remedy row and the ride phone below. A dark underline extends under under development across the samples. Caption below the card on the desk area.

Option A 58.0 to 58.8 s. The closing split of the open-door car above and the stamped remedy card below holds for about 0.4 s without caption, then at 58.6 s the film cuts to a dark credits card with a Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, and source, illustration, map and music credits.
Option A 59.0 to 59.8 s. The dark credits card holds unchanged: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the sources, illustration, map and music credit lines.
Option A 60.0 to 60.8 s. The same credits card holds without change: flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the credit block.
Option A 61.0 to 61.8 s. Credits card unchanged across all five samples: flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and credit block.
Option A 62.0 to 62.8 s. Credits card holds unchanged with flag, wordmark, URL and the credit block.
Option A 63.0 to 63.433 s (final frame 1903). The credits card holds unchanged through the last frame of the film.

Option B 0.0 to 0.8 s. Same airport curb opening as option A: a white car with a roof pod rolls in from the left toward the marked bay; phone card reads Ride requested. Caption appears below the car from 0.2 s.
Option B 1.0 to 1.8 s. The car brakes with a red rear glow and settles in the marked bay, then holds. Phone card still Ride requested. Car body sits just above the caption box.

Option B 2.0 to 2.8 s. The curb shot holds with the locator card drawing in, then at 2.6 s a cut to the cab behind two empty front seats: steering wheel, dash route screen and the airport sign beyond the windshield. Same as option A in this interval.

Option B 3.0 to 3.8 s. Cab view: the steering wheel turns by itself, its tan marker moving clockwise, while the airport sign slides off the right edge of the windshield and the dash route dot advances. Seats are empty. Matches option A here.
Option B 4.0 to 4.8 s. Cab view holds still: wheel marker at right, sign edge at the windshield right, empty seats, locator card with full Texas outline. No sampled movement in these frames.

Option B 5.0 to 5.8 s. Same as A: cab view ends, then a close curb shot with a large tilted phone over the left half of the parked car, still reading Ride requested. Caption the airport included below.
Option B 6.0 to 6.8 s. On the phone the car pin reaches the destination and the status flips to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s; the parked car holds behind. Caption clears at 6.6 s. Matches option A.

Option B 7.0 to 7.8 s. Overhead flat paper map fills the upper frame on an olive wall, with a faint grid, two pale green patches, three small pins and a February calendar page at lower left. River and roads start to draw at 7.8 s. Caption below the map.

Option B 8.0 to 8.8 s. On the overhead map a blue river line and a second blue line extend top to bottom while grey radial roads and a ring road draw in around three small pins. February page at lower left. Map above the caption box.

Option B 9.0 to 9.8 s. Overhead map holds, then at 9.4 s a cut to the same map lying on a wooden table. A 60 square miles, Limited area tag lands at the top, a February page slides in at lower right and a dark outline stroke begins at upper left. Caption below the map.

Option B 10.0 to 10.8 s. On the tabletop map the dark outline traces clockwise from the upper left across the top and down the right side, still open at 10.8 s. February page settles at lower left. Matches option A in this interval.
Option B 11.0 to 11.8 s. The dark outline closes into a polygon around the three pins and fills grey; tag 60 square miles, Limited area above. All above the caption box. Matches option A.
Option B 12.0 to 12.8 s. Completed shaded polygon holds; the pins drift slightly and a very small white car mark sits near the lower-left pin. Caption clears at 12.8 s. Same as option A.

Option B 13.0 to 13.8 s. Map holds at 13.0 s, then a straight-down creek plan: brown water with pale current streaks across the upper half, a pale sand shelf and green bank with round tree crowns below, and a white car from above at the bottom edge of the water with roof pod and dark empty seats visible and splash crescents at its right end. Car's lower edge sits just above the caption box top. Same picture as option A at these times.

Option B 14.0 to 14.8 s. Overhead creek: the white car stays at the lower edge of the brown water with splash crescents at its right end, then shifts and rotates slightly at 14.8 s. Car underside about level with the caption box top; car body above it. This page's image hash is identical to option A sequence-014.

Option B 15.0 to 15.8 s. The car pushes into the brown water with a growing splash; from 15.4 s a higher view shows both banks with the car in the water; by 15.8 s it is rotated about twenty degrees, drawn larger, with a dark offset shadow and trailing pale lines. Car stays above the caption box. Visually matches option A in this interval.

Option B 16.0 to 16.8 s. The rotated, enlarged white car with its offset shadow and front splash is carried left along the brown creek and exits the left frame edge; at 16.8 s only a sliver with splash remains. The car stays in the water band above the caption box. Matches option A.

Option B 17.0 to 17.8 s. The last splash fragment leaves the left edge and at 17.4 s the creek frame is empty with no caption. At 17.6 s cut to a flooded residential street with a white car in shallow brown water. Matches option A.

Option B 18.0 to 18.8 s. The white car moves slowly right along the flooded street as the brown water line rises over its wheels; by 18.6 s the lower wheels are submerged. Car just above caption box. Matches option A.
Option B 19.0 to 19.8 s. The car sits stopped in brown water near the frame center; amber lamps glow at both ends from 19.6 s. Car small in a wide frame just above the caption box. Matches option A.
Option B 20.0 to 20.8 s. Closer shot of the stopped car with water at its sills, empty headrests in the windows, and amber lamps blinking on and off. Car above the caption box. Matches option A.
Option B 21.0 to 21.8 s. The stranded empty car holds still in brown water with blinking amber lamps. Caption below the car. Matches option A.

Option B 22.0 to 22.8 s. Flood car held at 22.0 s, then a cut to an overhead brown desk panel on an olive wall where a cream Federal recall record card slides in from the right with a pen; at 22.8 s a field begins typing Reca, Sof. Card partly cropped at right; desk panel ends above the caption box.
Option B 23.0 to 23.8 s. The recall card settles on the overhead desk and its rows type in: Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791. Card and desk sit above the caption box.

Option B 24.0 to 24.8 s. The completed card holds on the desk, then at 24.6 s the framing shows the card at top and a faint empty grid of car outlines below; three white car icons fill the first row by 24.8 s. Same layout as option A here.

Option B 25.0 to 25.8 s. The white car icon grid fills row by row while a forearm in a blue sleeve brings a wooden stamp in from the right over the card. Grid ends just above the caption box. Same as option A.

Option B 26.0 to 26.8 s. With the full icon grid in place, a counter tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in and settles; the stamp lifts at 26.8 s to show an amber imprint beginning So. Same as option A.
Option B 27.0 to 27.8 s. The Software recall stamp stays on the card as the hand withdraws; the card, counter tag and full icon grid hold above the caption box. Same as option A.

Option B 28.0 to 28.8 s. Record composition holds, then at 28.4 s a cut to a straight-down view of a two-lane road with dashed center line and grass verges. A small white car seen from above travels up the right lane. At 28.6 s the caption box covers the lower half of the car; at 28.8 s the car is just above the caption. A pale recall sentence card fades in near the top. No standing water yet.

Option B 29.0 to 29.8 s. Top-down lane: the white car stays in the right lane just above the caption while the lane dashes scroll, and a grey standing water patch appears at the top edge from 29.2 s and grows down toward the car. The full recall sentence card is legible near the top, partly overlapping the water patch area.

Option B 30.0 to 30.8 s. The grey standing water patch now fills the right lane ahead of the car down to just below the recall card. The car holds just above the caption box; at 30.8 s tiny red brake marks appear at its rear. The recall card sits over the upper part of the water patch.

Option B 31.0 to 31.8 s. Top-down: the white car with red brake marks sits in the right lane below the leading edge of the grey water patch; dash movement slows. Car remains just above the caption box. The water patch is drawn as a flat grey shape with a few pale streaks.

Option B 32.0 to 32.8 s. In the top-down lane the braking car edges up toward the water patch but has not reached it when the shot ends; caption clears at 32.6 s. At 32.8 s cut to the same close side view as option A: the car large on the lane with a thin wavy line at the tires and the recall card above.

Option B 33.0 to 33.8 s. Same as option A: the close side view holds the white car while a pale standing water edge grows from the right toward its front wheel. Recall card above; may not yet highlighted. Car above caption box.

Option B 34.0 to 34.8 s. Same as option A: the front wheel moves onto the grey standing water with small spray, and the word may in the recall card is highlighted amber from 34.2 s. Car above the caption box.

Option B 35.0 to 35.8 s. Same as option A: the car drives on in the grey standing water with V-shaped wake lines and a faint reflection; may remains highlighted. Wake's lowest lines touch the caption box top; the car itself is above it.
Option B 36.0 to 36.8 s. Same as option A: the car keeps driving in the standing water with wake and reflection under the highlighted may card; the caption clears at 36.6 s. No stop is drawn.

Option B 37.0 to 37.8 s. The card lies flat on the overhead desk with its Software recall stamp; a Remedy row types The remedy is currently under development. and lights pale amber. Card above the caption box.
Option B 38.0 to 38.8 s. On the flat card, a hand brings a pen in from the right and rests its tip at the end of the lit remedy line under development. Card above caption box.

Option B 39.0 to 39.8 s. Same as option A: with the pen hand resting at the remedy line, a second arm brings a wooden stamp over the lower remedy row from the lower right. Two forearms enter from the right edge at once. Stamp arm's sleeve reaches toward the caption band; card above it.

Option B 40.0 to 40.8 s. Same as option A: the stamp presses then lifts away, leaving an amber Under development imprint under the remedy text while the pen hand stays at the line. Imprint above the caption box.

Option B 41.0 to 41.8 s. Same as option A: the stamped card holds as both arms withdraw, then at 41.6 s a cut to a wet lot with four white cars in a diagonal row, a Vehicle maps card on a wire and an April page; a tag reading ther limits slides in at the top left.

Option B 42.0 to 42.8 s. Same as option A: the Weather limits, tightened tag with a rain cloud icon slides along the overhead wire and pins near the center while the parked cars hold still above the caption box.
Option B 43.0 to 43.8 s. Same as option A: the lot composition holds with only a slight shift and tilt of the Weather limits tag at 43.8 s.
Option B 44.0 to 44.8 s. Same as option A: the lot holds; only the Weather limits tag rocks slightly.

Option B 45.0 to 45.8 s. Same as option A: the wide lot holds, then at 45.6 s a cut to a closer view with the front car large and the row receding right, the Weather limits tag at top left and the April page at right. No check marks yet.
Option B 46.0 to 46.8 s. Same as option A: round check badges appear above each car roof in sequence from front to back; four visible by 46.8 s. April page still shows no number.
Option B 47.0 to 47.8 s. Same as option A: all cars show check badges and a small check is added to the Vehicle maps card. April page still shows no date number.
Option B 48.0 to 48.8 s. Same as option A: the checked row holds and the small calendar page at the right flips to a large 20 at 48.8 s.
Option B 49.0 to 49.8 s. Same as option A: April 20 calendar at right, checks over cars and maps card; caption clears at 49.8 s.

Option B 50.0 to 50.8 s. Same as option A: return to the airport curb with the white car parked in the bay and the phone card reading Arriving. Chip reads Illustration. A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. Doors closed in these samples.
Option B 51.0 to 51.8 s. Same as option A: the parked car's rear door swings open from 51.2 s, revealing a tan seat. Door is small at phone size. Car above the caption box.

Option B 52.0 to 52.8 s. Same as option A: the open-door car holds at the curb, then at 52.8 s a wider view with a phone on the bench and a small recall card with the remedy row lying in the road foreground.
Option B 53.0 to 53.8 s. Same as option A: the open-door car waits at the curb while the small recall card in the foreground settles; card just above the caption box.

Option B 54.0 to 54.8 s. Same as option A: the recall card slides forward and enlarges; from 54.4 s it overlaps the bottom of the car and by 54.6 s covers its lower-left wheel and door area. Card sits directly above the caption box.
Option B 55.0 to 55.8 s. Same as option A: the open-door car and the recall card in front of it hold; the card covers the lower part of the car's left side and sits directly above the caption box.

Option B 56.0 to 56.8 s. Same as option A: at 56.4 s the frame splits into the open-door car at the curb above and the stamped recall card with a small route phone on a desk below. Caption below the card.
Option B 57.0 to 57.8 s. Same as option A: the split holds with the open-door car above and the stamped remedy card and phone below while an underline draws beneath under development.

Option B 58.0 to 58.8 s. Same as option A: the closing split of the open-door car above and the stamped remedy card below holds about 0.4 s without caption, then cuts at 58.6 s to the dark credits card with flag, Texas AI Docket, URL and credits.
Option B 59.0 to 59.8 s. Credits card holds unchanged with flag, wordmark, texasaidocket.com and the source, illustration, map and music credits.
Option B 60.0 to 60.8 s. Credits card unchanged across all five samples.
Option B 61.0 to 61.8 s. Credits card unchanged: flag, wordmark, texasaidocket.com and credit block.
Option B 62.0 to 62.8 s. Credits card holds unchanged with flag, wordmark, URL and credits.
Option B 63.0 to 63.433 s (final frame 1903). The credits card holds unchanged through the last frame.
